notes: Modified cash basis city (FYE 9/30/2023); governmental activities modified cash, business-type activities accrual (the government-wide Statement of Activities business-type column is itself accrual and ties to the proprietary statement p7). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5): fund-balance roll-forward 426,616 + 1,165,110 - 990,663 + transfers in 30,492 = 631,555. No prior-year balance sheet, so beginning cash is null; ending cash = cash lines of the governmental funds balance sheet (p4), certificates of deposit 39,965 in ending_investments. Business-type: proprietary statement Total column (p7); beginning net position restated (as originally reported 2,806,482, restatement (46,271), as restated 2,760,211); 2,760,211 + 1,121,996 - 781,721 - 30,492 = 3,069,994. Gas Fund transfers 30,492 to the General Fund. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4; totals equal the Statement of Net Position governmental column: assets 631,986, liabilities 431 shown there as accrued expenses, net position 631,555), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1); totals from the p1 Total column. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (pp12-13, one line per department column; more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p10, which is not recorded to avoid double counting); Street Fund budget schedule (p11). Gas/Water/Sewer have no schedule of their own; their statement-column lines are not in detail (as FY2024: when some funds have their own schedules, statement lines are not added for the others). CDA Fund has no schedule. 'Public works' on the statement combines Street Fund 168,717 with General Fund sanitation 57,149 and cemetery 5,142. Read pages 1-13 of 13
